name: Muse voice and expressive avatars
desc: Voice conversations and animated avatars for your Muse
desc_zh: 为 Muse 带来语音对话和表情化虚拟形象
solves: Typing every request slows you down; now you talk to Muse and it answers with an expressive avatar.
solves_zh: 每件事都要打字太慢，现在可以直接和 Muse 对话，它用表情形象回应你。
best_for: You are cooking and want to ask Muse about the day without touching your phone.
best_for_zh: 正在做饭，想不碰手机就问问 Muse 今天的安排。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://about.fb.com/news/ (About Meta newsroom)）。 In-product surface of Muse (in the ledger at 2026-09-08). Rolling out in the US first; voice on AI Glasses and Muse Charm was announced as coming soon. No independent second source located. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：原名_zh 是评审范围外的自拟译名，不是厂商公布的中文名；按规则没有官方中文名时与 name 相同。 首次公开日期来源：https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-muse-ai-voice-expressive-avatars/
